decision.title: You Need Me (2009)
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (5 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/master/764405-Ed-Sheeran-You-Need-Me, https://www.simplygames.com/p/ed-sheeran-you-need-me-cd. 2009 independent CD/12" EP (Sheeran Lock). 5 tracks confirmed across Discogs master 764405, multiple retail tracklist pages (simplygames, cultureshockshop, everybodysrecords, riverbendrecords) and press (The Spectator). Reissued 2011 (Paw Print) and 2016 (Atlantic/Gingerbread Man vinyl). THIS IS THE SAME RELEASE as the duplicate entry 'You Need Me' - same artist, same year, same 5-track tracklist; one is a year-suffixed duplicate row.
